description: Get full details for a specific trip segment. Returns complete information based on segment type: flight details (airline, flight number, airports, terminals, seats, baggage), hotel details (property, address, check-in/out times, room type, amenities), activity details (venue, tickets, timing), event ticket details (event name, venue, timing, vendor, order, confirmation), car rental details (company, vehicle, pickup/dropoff locations), or transfer details (provider, transfer type, pickup/dropoff locations, addresses, and local times). bookingContext describes whether Tineo can prepare an in-app reviewed change or needs the full editor; it is not a save confirmation or additional write authority.

segment_id.description: The unique identifier of the segment to fetch details for
